profile.name: Children's Rehabilitation Center
profile.description:
Children's Rehabilitation Center is the premier pediatric outpatient facility. We strive to instill hope by promoting independence and self-esteem. Our passionate teams of experts take a family approach so that every child feels loved and inspired to reach their full potential. 

Located halfway between Cleveland and Pittsburgh in Warren, Ohio, Children's Rehabilitation Center serves the tri-county area (Trumbull, Mahoning and Columbiana counties) and beyond.

Families come to our Center seeking the very best care, along with excellence, compassion and professionalism. We share these same values and deliver!

Children's Rehabilitation Center is committed to empowering children to develop:

More confidence,
Determination, and
New skills to meet life's various challenges.
